note: This vocabulary freezes the economic targets for HMR-V3. Return definitions must align with trade perspective (e.g. favorable return for SELL matches price drops).

path_sensitive.MFE_30BPS_BEFORE_MAE_30BPS: maximum favorable excursion >= 30 bps achieved before maximum adverse excursion >= 30 bps
path_sensitive.MFE_40BPS_BEFORE_MAE_20BPS: maximum favorable excursion >= 40 bps achieved before maximum adverse excursion >= 20 bps
path_sensitive.TARGET_BEFORE_ADVERSE_MOVE: target bps hit before hitting maximum tolerable adverse move
